provenance_note: Track 0.514 is the model centre-to-centre estimate; not independently measured hardware. Body width is not used in wheel conversion.
frame_note: User identifies lidar end as front, original base_link -X. Logical planning +X means physical front. yaw_plan=wrap(yaw_base+pi); v_base=-v_plan; omega_base=omega_plan. Logical left/right are swapped relative to original +X convention; joint signs unverified.
environment_note: Demo is synthetic; real room geometry/scale must be supplied as a consistent occupied-cell map. No factory speed, steering-radius or 4WS parameters imported.
